definition: Two parts of a procedure drawing from different distributions, so a component calibrated on one behaves wrongly on the other. Both sources diagnose a failure this way rather than treating it as noise. The reproduction study finds a conditional steering gate inert because it fires on 98 percent of tokens: the gate is 0.88-separable on its reference sentences, but those are short conclusions while the task tokens come from ordinary generation, so nearly every task token classifies as steer-worthy and the conditional variant degenerates into static steering. Removing the mismatch by building a task whose reference and steering activations come from the same distribution produced that study's only positive steering result. The distillation work identifies the same structure inside an objective: student-deficit tokens are preferred by the teacher and almost never sampled by the student, so 95.5 percent of them have under a one percent chance of appearing in on-policy supervision and no update reaches them -- which is why that paper injects teacher mass analytically instead of waiting for the sample. The shared lesson is that a component's separability or accuracy measured on one distribution says nothing about its behaviour on another, and the diagnostic is cheap: check the firing rate, or the coverage.

evidence.note: Independently reproduces two published reliability methods and stress-tests them across models and domains their authors never tried, finding one reproduces exactly but loses significance everywhere new, and the other rests on a decodable logic direction that a same-norm random direction matches exactly under steering.
evidence.title: Reproducing and Stress-Testing Two Approaches to LLM Reasoning Reliability: Test-Time Probability Aggregation and Logic-Representation Editing

evidence.note: Identifies degenerate agreement -- students reaching near-perfect token agreement with a teacher by looping while the response as a whole is broken -- and replaces the agreement objective with two directional mismatch corrections, one bounding runaway excess tokens and one injecting teacher-preferred mass at positions the student almost never samples.
evidence.title: Mismatch Matters: On-Policy Distillation Beyond Token Agreement

name: distribution mismatch
